title: Code Factory: Proof-by-Sabotage Software Factory
description:
Code Factory is a proof-first, open-source software factory for turning specifications, behavior checks, design contracts, policy verification, Mermaid diagrams, and release receipts into auditable delivery through Unified Graph Ops. Version 0.33 adds Evidence Frontier: it binds the current ProofSearch evaluation, ranks user-supplied non-executing experiment hypotheses by how many viable repair pairs they separate, labels predictions as unverified, and halts when no supplied experiment discriminates. The Graph Ops Evidence Frontier displays ranked next-evidence hypotheses, a sealed receipt, and copy/export/validation controls while experiment execution remains locked. Release media includes the current FactoryLine identity asset and real product captures.

Evidence boundary: Evidence Frontier does not generate or apply patches, execute candidate commands, mutate workspaces, tests, or checkpoints, approve, merge, publish, deploy, sign, message, access credentials, or grant connectors. Time, token, and cost savings require exact paired observations; productivity remains unavailable without separate measured evidence. A passing receipt proves the declared checks and supplied environment, not arbitrary production security.
